PLAN "Full 12-Week Remote Strength Programme Summary (Beginner, 27, Minimal Equipment)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational total-body strength safely with bodyweight and minimal equipment over 12 weeks; include mobility, cardio, nutrition, and a Saturday finisher"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation intro":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bodyweight_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chair_dip 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          squat 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x9..13 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dip 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation consolidation":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x10..14 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dip 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..18 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation wrap-up":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x11..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dip 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12..18 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_bridge 3x12..18 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression and push intensity A":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dip 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x10..14 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_bridge 3x12..18 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression and push intensity B":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x9..13 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 4x9..13 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dip 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x11..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..18 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Push intensity peak A":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x10..14 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x12..16 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..14 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 60 seconds
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Push intensity peak B":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x11..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 4x9..13 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dip 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x12..17 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_bridge 3x14..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds

  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength emphasis A":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 5x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dip 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 5x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength emphasis B":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x7..11 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 5x7..11 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dip 4x7..11 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 5x9..13 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x9..13 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength emphasis C":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 5x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dip 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 5x10..14 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10..14 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Deload and reassessment":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dip 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..14 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 60 seconds

  SATURDAY FINISHER DAY
    WEEK 1–4:
      DAY Saturday finisher 20m "Fun Burner 1":
        main:
          3 rounds:
            mountain_climber 45 seconds
            rest 15 seconds
            jumping_jack 45 seconds
            rest 15 seconds
            high_knees 45 seconds
            rest 30 seconds
    WEEK 5–8:
      DAY Saturday finisher 25m "Fun Burner 2":
        main:
          4 rounds:
            burpee without push-up 30 seconds
            rest 15 seconds
            squat_jump 30 seconds
            rest 15 seconds
            box_step 30 seconds
            rest 30 seconds
    WEEK 9–12:
      DAY Saturday finisher 30m "Fun Burner 3":
        main:
          5 rounds:
            tuck_jump 20 seconds
            rest 10 seconds
            bear_crawl 20 seconds
            rest 15 seconds
            sprint_in_place 20 seconds
            rest 25 seconds

  MOBILITY
    GOAL: Improve joint range, tissue quality, and movement efficiency to support the plan
    PHASE "Mobility Core" (4 weeks):
      WEEK 1:
        DAY Tuesday training 20m "Mobility for hips and shoulders":
          main mobility:
            hip_circles 2x10 reps each direction
            ankle_circles 2x10 reps each direction
            thoracic_rotation 2x10 reps each side
            shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
            chest_stretch 60 seconds
      WEEK 2:
        DAY Tuesday training 20m "Mobility progression":
          main mobility:
            goblet_squat to hold 2s bottom 2x10
            hip_opening_sequence 2x8 per side
            thoracic_extension_stretch 60 seconds
            lat_stretch 60 seconds
      WEEK 3:
        DAY Tuesday training 25m "Shoulder and spine mobility":
          main mobility:
            doorway_frame_stretch 2x30s per arm
            thoracic_rotation 2x12 per side
            thread_the_needle 3x6 per side
            wall_slide 2x8
      WEEK 4:
        DAY Tuesday training 25m "Full-body mobility wrap-up":
          main mobility:
            hip_flexor_stretch 2x60s per side
            glute_manual_release 2x60s per side
            quadricep_stretch 60s per side
            quadruped_opposite_arm reach 2x8 per side
      CD:
        cooldown:
          deep_breathing 2x5 cycles
    PHASE "Mobility Maintenance" (8 weeks):
      WEEK 5–12:
        DAY Tuesday training 15–20m "Maintenance mobility":
          main mobility:
            6–8 movements chosen from:
              hip_circles, ankle_circles, thoracic_rotation, doorway_frame_stretch, thread_the_needle, wall_slide, lat_stretch, cobra_pose, child_pose
          cooldown:
            diaphragmatic_breathing 2x5 cycles

  NUTRITION PLAN
    GOAL: Support strength gains, recovery, and energy levels with a simple, sustainable intake.
    (Included as per previous nutrition plan)

CARDIO PLAN (HOME-BASED)
  GOAL: Maintain cardiovascular fitness with minimal equipment, integrated with strength blocks.
  STRUCTURE
    - Frequency: 3–4 sessions per week on non-consecutive days or after light strength days
    - Duration: 15–25 minutes per session (progressing to 30 minutes as tolerated)
    - Intensity: mostly low-moderate; include occasional higher-intensity intervals
  MODALITIES
    - walking, jog_in_place, jump_rope, stair_step (where available)
  WORKOUT TEMPLATES
    - Cardio A (steady state)
      - warmup: walking 3 minutes
      - main: jog_in_place 8–12 minutes at conversation pace
      - cooldown: walking 2 minutes
    - Cardio B (intervals)
      - warmup: jog_in_place 3 minutes
      - main: 6 rounds of (30 seconds high effort, 60 seconds easy)
      - cooldown: walking 3 minutes
    - Cardio C (skill/neuromuscular)
      - 5 rounds of 1 minute of mountain_climber, 1 minute rest
  PROGRESSION
    - Increase duration by 5 minutes every 2 weeks if tolerating
    - For intervals, increase work time or reduce rest gradually
  SAFETY
    - Prioritize joint comfort; discontinue if pain persists
  NOTES
    - Space-conscious plan; avoid jumps if space limited
  IMPLEMENTATION
    - Integrate Cardio A on Weeks 1–4, Cardio B Weeks 5–8, Cardio C Weeks 9–12, rotating days with strength sessions

STRUCTURE NOTES
- Pull-up/chin-up progressions substituted as needed; use doorway bar safely.
- Sessions rely on bodyweight/minimal equipment; adjust reps/volume per form.
- 1–2 rest days between train days; Saturday Finisher optional.
- Schedule mobility on Tuesdays; can slot after warmups on strength days if preferred.

END PLAN

    - Maintenance baseline: estimate 15–18 kcal per pound of body weight per day as starting point; adjust by 0.25–0.5 kg per week based on progress and wellbeing.

    - Carbohydrates: 3–5 g per kg body weight per day (higher on training days)
    - Fats: remainder of calories after protein and carbs

    - 3 main meals + 1–2 snacks
    - Protein at each meal (roughly 0.25–0.4 g per kg per meal)
    - Include fiber-rich vegetables with each meal
